owner_decision.may: authorise or decline a proposed evaluation; set scope
owner_decision.may_not: act as independent labeler or adjudicator of work they commissioned

independent_labeler.may_not: have built or tuned the candidate

adjudicator.may: resolve labeler disagreements under a recorded procedure
adjudicator.may_not: be a labeler on the same items or have built the candidate

technical_operator.may: run the frozen candidate under the protocol
technical_operator.may_not: change prompt, codebook or compiler after freeze

counsel.may: review data flows, privacy and claims

production_qa.may_not: be the developer of the build

release_authority.may: record a release decision after gates 1 to 4 and production QA
release_authority.may_not: treat local tests as release evidence

local_engineering.may: build and test local candidates on synthetic material
local_engineering.may_not: convert local work into independent validation, counsel disposition, production evidence or release authorisation
